title: Fossil Just Made a Watch for Doctor DOOM 😈
description:
Fossil just made a watch for Doctor Doom — the villain. 😈

The Fossil × Marvel Avengers: Doomsday collection is four limited-edition watches: Doctor Doom, Thor and Gambit (44 mm) and an ana-digi Mr. Fantastic (46 mm) with dual time. Fossil says Gambit's rotor-weighted movement and pink lume make the dial look like it spins when you flick your wrist. Each one is $325 in the US (£329 in the UK), with wider availability from November 26 — ahead of the film on December 18.

The catch: every caseback is numbered "limited edition", but Fossil hasn't said how many it's making.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 68/100 → SPEC. Grab one if you want Marvel on your wrist before the movie.

Spec or wreck? Tell us below.
